name: weekly-self-review
purpose: Perform the weekly self‑review of the AI Factory, counting how many bots were created during the week and reporting the total.
instructions: Read the weekly creation log file (e.g., bots.txt) from the workspace. Each line represents one bot created. Count the lines, write the result to a file named review.txt, and output only the final count as a single token. If the log file does not exist, create it yourself with write_file before reading. Never execute shell commands, never modify files other than those you create, and never include explanatory text in the final output.
